summary: Iteration 129: Key Vault Feature - 18/18 BACKEND TESTS PASSED, ALL FRONTEND UI TESTS PASSED. Fixed 1 bug: inject_and_reload() was not passing category/description to store(). All vault endpoints work correctly with admin-only access (403 for non-admin), AES-256-GCM encryption, key preview format (first 8 + ... + last 4 chars), and proper CRUD operations.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 129 tested the NEW Key Vault feature. All tests pass: (1) Auth tests verify admin-only access for GET/POST/DELETE /api/vault/keys, (2) Non-admin users get 403, (3) Store key persists with category/description, (4) Key preview format is first 8 chars + ... + last 4 chars, (5) Delete removes key from list, (6) Frontend: Admin Panel has Vault tab with Lock icon, missing keys alert shows OPENAI_API_KEY etc., Add Key form has name/value(password)/category/description fields, stored keys show with preview and delete button.

bugs_fixed.issue: inject_and_reload() method was not passing category and description parameters to store() method, causing all keys to be stored with default 'general' category and empty description
bugs_fixed.fix: Updated inject_and_reload() signature to accept category, description, stored_by parameters and pass them to store()

bugs_fixed.issue: store_vault_key endpoint was calling inject_and_reload() with only name and value, ignoring req.category and req.description
bugs_fixed.fix: Updated call to pass req.category, req.description, and user.get('email', 'admin') as stored_by
